children: OPAY UPDATES ON PREVIOUSLY ANNOUNCED OFFERING
OPAY: INQUIRY RELATING TO A JURISDICTION IS IMMATERIAL TO THE COMPANY’S CORE BUSINESS OPERATIONS
OPAY- DETERMINED THAT NOT PROCEEDING WITH THE OFFERING AT THIS TIME WOULD BE THE MOST PRUDENT COURSE OF ACTION
OPAY- OFFERING WILL NOT BE COMPLETED, AND THE COMPANY’S ADSS WILL NOT COMMENCE TRADING ON THE NEW YORK STOCK EXCHANGE AS PREVIOUSLY SCHEDULED
OPAY: THIS DEVELOPMENT SHOULD NOT BE MISCONSTRUED AS A REFLECTION ON THE COMPANY’S BUSINESS PERFORMANCE
OPAY: THIS DEVELOPMENT HAS NO IMPACT ON OPAY’S BUSINESS OPERATIONS IN NIGERIA OR ANY OTHER MARKET IN WHICH THE COMPANY OPERATES
OPAY- REMAINS CONFIDENT THAT THE INQUIRY WILL BE RESOLVED SATISFACTORILY IN THE NEAR FUTURE
OPAY: CO AND THE UNDERWRITERS MUTUALLY AGREED TO TERMINATE THE UNDERWRITING AGREEMENT DATED OCTOBER 29, 2026, RELATING TO THE OFFERING
